comparator.sourceNotes: The official prospective year pages give 60+60+60=180 EC and explicitly mark the 2026–27 overviews as provisional. Year one lists 52 EC compulsory university courses plus the required 8-EC Bachelorstage 1. Year two lists 48 EC university courses, required 8-EC Bachelorstage 2 and 4 EC genuine academic choice; Analyse 3 is one optional example. Year three lists 31 EC university courses including the 10-EC bachelor thesis, required 7-EC Bachelorstage 3 and 10-EC Afstudeerstage, plus 12 EC genuine academic choice; three named orthopedagogical/professional 4-EC courses are optional instances, not universal requirements. Total required credited primary-school placements are 8+8+7+10=33 EC. The prospectus says graduates receive a bachelor degree with primary-teaching qualification, while the selected ordinary route includes subject didactics, classroom management and final supervised independent teaching. The 0-EC RADAr assessment is excluded. Concurrent prospectus year pages do not guarantee a fixed three-year entrant-cohort schedule.

routeSelection.route: Pedagogische Wetenschappen van Primair Onderwijs, ordinary three-year teaching-qualification route
routeSelection.basis: The target is the single ordinary PWPO bachelor rather than the distinct Pedagogical Sciences or ALPO programme. The 4-EC and 12-EC open choices remain open; optional Analyse 3 and orthopedagogy electives are not imposed as a specialization. All four compulsory placements remain present.

core: Children’s cognitive, language, social, emotional and physical development
Primary teaching, subject didactics, classroom management and supervised practice
Educational research, evidence appraisal, measurement and classroom inquiry
School and society, supportive learning environments, pupil rights and professional ethics
adjacent: Children’s learning difficulties, mental health and educational support
Language, rhetoric and communication with primary-school pupils
questions: How do young children learn, communicate and develop?
How can research and evidence improve children’s learning and school environments?

candidates.label: Primary teaching, subject didactics & supervised practice
candidates.reason: Rhetoric in Action provides one school-linked speaking and debate project, and several courses study child development, language and evidence. UCR has no cumulative curriculum in literacy, numeracy and primary-subject didactics, classroom management or supervised teaching practice from which to build a separate 24-course teacher-education route.

alternatives.label: Child development, language & educational inquiry
alternatives.labelReason: Developmental, cognitive and social psychology, four communication courses and four research-methods courses form the curriculum’s centre; the label avoids implying teacher qualification or a primary-subject didactics sequence.
alternatives.concept: Study how children develop, process language, learn and participate in social environments through developmental and social psychology, cognition, communication and empirical research. One course includes a supervised speaking-and-debate project with primary pupils, but the programme does not provide primary-subject didactics, sustained classroom placements, classroom-management training or teacher qualification.
progression: Introduction to Brain & Behavior precedes every dependent cognition and psychology course; research foundations precede advanced statistics, data analysis and research synthesis. The introductory communication and social-science courses precede school-linked and advanced applications. All courses have exact planned offerings, and eight are at 300 level.

selection.assessment: Child development, language and educational inquiry is the strongest complete related-fields response. The next candidate—primary teaching, subject didactics and supervised practice—fails because UCR offers only one school-linked communication project and no cumulative literacy, numeracy, classroom-management or placement sequence. Learning difficulties and school quality are supporting topics rather than independent generator-eligible directions, so production stops at one.

notes.text: Radboud PWPO integrates child development and educational research with primary-subject didactics, classroom management, 33 EC of supervised teaching placements and a primary-teaching qualification. UCR can study child development, cognition, language, mental health, school society and research, including one primary-school rhetoric project. It does not provide the professional curriculum or placements required to qualify as a primary teacher.
